name: RadioButton
purpose: A single radio input — the individual option unit RadioGroup renders per choice, exposed on its own for cases that need one radio outside a full group (e.g. a single option embedded in a custom layout, or a hand-assembled set sharing `name`).
neverUseFor: A set of mutually exclusive options — use RadioGroup instead, which renders one of these per option with the correct fieldset/legend wrapper for free
A single independent on/off choice — use Checkbox or Switch instead
Anything needing search or many options — use Select instead
rationale: RadioButton is the exact native radio option RadioGroup renders, exposed on its own only for custom layouts that still share a `name`. It keeps the same fixed 16px control as Checkbox; for a normal set of options RadioGroup should be used because it adds fieldset/legend for free.

mayExtendLocally: Place a single radio inside a custom layout sharing `name`
mustEscalateToDS: Adding a size prop or new control sizes
Building full option sets by hand instead of using RadioGroup

authored.name: checked
authored.description: Whether this radio is selected. Controlled via `checked`, uncontrolled via `defaultChecked` — same split as Switch.

anatomy.description: Wraps the input, visual control, and content — identical anatomy to one RadioGroup option, so it shares all of RadioGroup's CSS with no duplication.
Visual circle — reflects checked state via CSS.
Inner filled dot shown when checked.
Visible label. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

The required indicator (*) inside the label, text/danger, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the text — shown by `required`, like Checkbox. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Helper text. Sits exactly 4px below the label — same structure as Checkbox's own description. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
Error text, shown instead of the description when `errorMessage` is set — identical structure to Checkbox's own error message.

props.name: name
props.description: Native radio group name, shared with any sibling RadioButtons it should be mutually exclusive with. Auto-generated (unique to this instance) if omitted — meaning it won't group with anything unless you set this explicitly.

props.name: value
props.description: Native radio value, read from the form on submit. Defaults to the native 'on' if omitted.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown under the label. Not shown when errorMessage is also set.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Error text shown under the label when invalid is true — takes over from description.

height.note: Same fixed 16px control as RadioGroup's own option — this IS that option, standalone.

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis: hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code. checked,  invalid and disabled are their own false/true toggles (contracts/figma-conversion.json,  pattern checkable).

properties.name: description.
properties.description: Show/hide part: a line in radio-item-content (4px gap only between shown lines).

properties.name: errorMessage.
properties.description: Show/hide part: the error line. Code shows it instead of the description — turn description off when it is on.

figma.structure: radio-item > radio-control-box (21px = lineHeight/m,  the circle centered on the label first line) + radio-item-content (radio-item-label [text + radio-item-required],  description,  error).
figma.variantCombinations: 14 variants (2026-10-20): checked false/true × invalid false/true × state default/hover/focus = 12,  plus disabled for each checked value at state default,  valid = 2 — the standard rule for disabled. Disabled dims label,  required * and description (text/disabled).

KeyboardSelect.reason: keyboard focus — the focus ring is drawn in Figma (owner 2026-10-21: focus states are drawn)
